quarterly_data.signal: Honeywell Aerospace 8-K (Q2 2026 earnings release): backlog $18,154 million at quarter end, up 9% from $16,600 million; net income $256 million and adjusted EBIT $995 million, down 7%, including approximately $100 million of separation-related costs and inventory obsolescence charges (figures excluding pro forma standalone adjustments); adjusted EPS $1.87 versus $2.75. Versus previous guidance, 2026 organic growth was cut from 7% - 9% to 4% - 5% and pro forma standalone adjusted EBIT from $4.65B - $4.75B to $4.35B - $4.45B (year-over-year growth from 7% - 10% to Flat - 3%). Supply actions include planned supplier tooling spending up 20% in the second half versus the first half; IndiGo selected its avionics and power systems for an order of 810 new Airbus A320neo family aircraft.
